use_pmap_parallelize: use the pmap shortcut to parallelize a function across the qmc_pmap_axis in JAX
use_psum_reduce: use the psum shortcut to compute a parallel sum across the qmc_pmap_axis
use_pmean_reduce: use the pmean shortcut to compute a parallel mean across the qmc_pmap_axis
use_all_gather_collect: use the all_gather shortcut to collect values from all devices across the qmc_pmap_axis
review_PMAP_AXIS_NAME: review the PMAP_AXIS_NAME constant used as the axis name for all FermiNet pmap operations
